description: This file defines a feature in the application to retrieve article details by slug, including a query, validator, and handler implementing MediatR pattern.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Request object containing the article slug.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to fetch article data based on slug.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Performs the database query to retrieve the article and returns an envelope or throws NotFound.
